48	        if not isinstance(item, bool):
49	            raise ValueError(f"{field} values must be bool")

53	def _validate_rules(rules: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
54	    if not isinstance(rules, list):
55	        raise ValueError("rules must be a list of rule dicts")
56	    seen: set[tuple[str, str, int]] = set()
57	    for index, rule in enumerate(rules):
58	        field = f"rules[{index}]"
59	        if not isinstance(rule, dict) or set(rule) != _RULE_KEYS:
60	            raise ValueError(
61	                f"{field} must be a dict with exactly the keys "
62	                "id, ver, source, priority, from, to, when, result"
63	            )
64	        _check_non_empty_str(rule["id"], f"{field}.id")
65	        _check_non_empty_str(rule["result"], f"{field}.result")
66	        ver = _check_int(rule["ver"], f"{field}.ver")

110	        rule
111	        for rule in rules
112	        if rule["from"] <= at and (rule["to"] is None or at < rule["to"])
113	    ]
114	
115	    latest: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
116	    for rule in effective:
117	        key = (rule["source"], rule["id"])
118	        if key not in latest or rule["ver"] > latest[key]["ver"]:
119	            latest[key] = rule
120	
121	    ranked = list(latest.values())
122	    ranked.sort(key=cmp_to_key(_compare))
123	    return ranked

126	def _matches(rule: dict[str, Any], facts: dict[str, bool]) -> bool:
127	    """Return whether ``rule``'s ``when`` condition holds under ``facts``."""
128	    when = rule["when"]
129	    return when is None or all(
130	        key in facts and facts[key] == value for key, value in when.items()
131	    )
132	
133	
134	def _matched_rules(
135	    at: str, facts: dict[str, bool], rules: list[dict[str, Any]]
136	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
137	    """Return the matching rules in ranking order after validation.
138	
139	    Validation, latest-version selection, and ordering are exactly those of
140	    :func:`evaluate`.
141	    """
142	    _check_fact_map(facts, "facts")
143	    ranked = _effective_rules(at, rules)
144	    return [rule for rule in ranked if _matches(rule, facts)]
145	
146	
147	def evaluate(
148	    at: str, facts: dict[str, bool], rules: list[dict[str, Any]]
149	) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
150	    """Evaluate versioned rules against facts at a UTC second timestamp.
151	
152	    Returns ``(decision, trace)`` where ``trace`` lists every matching rule as
153	    ``id@ver`` in ranking order and ``decision`` is the top rule's ``result``
154	    (``None`` with an empty trace when nothing matches).
155	    """
156	    matched = _matched_rules(at, facts, rules)
157	    if not matched:
158	        return None, []
159	    trace = [f"{rule['id']}@{rule['ver']}" for rule in matched]
160	    return matched[0]["result"], trace
161	
162	
163	def _conditions_compatible(a: dict[str, bool] | None, b: dict[str, bool] | None) -> bool:
164	    """Return whether two ``when`` conditions can hold simultaneously.
165	
166	    ``None`` means unconstrained. Conditions are incompatible only when they
167	    assign opposite booleans to a shared key.
168	    """
169	    if a is None or b is None:
170	        return True
171	    for key, value in a.items():
172	        if key in b and b[key] is not value:
173	            return False
174	    return True
175	
176	
177	def _snapshot_rule(rule: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
178	    """Return a deep-copied rule snapshot with stable key order.
179	
180	    Keys are ordered ``id, ver, source, priority, from, to, when, result``
181	    and ``when`` keys are sorted in Unicode code point order.
182	    """
183	    when = rule["when"]
184	    if when is not None:
185	        when = {key: when[key] for key in sorted(when)}
186	    return {
187	        "id": rule["id"],
188	        "ver": rule["ver"],
189	        "source": rule["source"],
190	        "priority": rule["priority"],
191	        "from": rule["from"],
192	        "to": rule["to"],
193	        "when": when,
194	        "result": rule["result"],
195	    }
196	
197	
198	def _find_conflicts(ranked: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
199	    """List conflicts between ranked rules as ``winner``/``loser`` triples.
200	
201	    For ranked indices ``i < j``, a pair conflicts when the results differ
202	    and the ``when`` conditions can hold simultaneously; the earlier rule is
203	    the winner.
204	    """
205	    conflicts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
206	    for i in range(len(ranked)):
207	        winner = ranked[i]
208	        for j in range(i + 1, len(ranked)):
209	            loser = ranked[j]
210	            if winner["result"] != loser["result"] and _conditions_compatible(
211	                winner["when"], loser["when"]
212	            ):
213	                conflicts.append(
214	                    {
215	                        "winner": [winner["source"], winner["id"], winner["ver"]],
216	                        "loser": [loser["source"], loser["id"], loser["ver"]],
217	                    }
218	                )
219	    return conflicts
220	
221	
222	def compile_rules(at: str, rules: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
223	    """Compile the rules effective at ``at`` into rules and conflicts.
224	
225	    Reuses the full validation of :func:`evaluate` for ``at`` and ``rules``
226	    (raising ``ValueError`` on anything invalid), keeps rules in their
227	    ``[from, to)`` window, retains only the highest ``ver`` per
228	    ``(source, id)``, and orders the survivors with :func:`evaluate`'s ranking.
229	
230	    ``conflicts`` lists, for ranked indices ``i < j``, pairs whose results
231	    differ and whose ``when`` conditions can hold simultaneously; the earlier
232	    rule is the winner. The returned structure is a deep copy with stable key
233	    order.
234	    """
235	    ranked = _effective_rules(at, rules)
236	    compiled_rules = [_snapshot_rule(rule) for rule in ranked]
237	    conflicts = _find_conflicts(ranked)
238	    return {"at": at, "rules": compiled_rules, "conflicts": conflicts}
239	
240	
241	def policy_attestation(at: str, rules: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
242	    """Attest a :func:`compile_rules` result with a SHA-256 digest.
243	
244	    ``at`` and ``rules`` are validated exactly as in :func:`compile_rules`;
245	    any type, time, rule-field, ``[from, to)`` interval, or duplicate
246	    ``(source, id, ver)`` error raises ``ValueError`` without mutating the
247	    inputs.
248	
249	    Let ``policy`` be the :func:`compile_rules` result and let ``C`` be the
250	    UTF-8 bytes of ``json.dumps(policy, ensure_ascii=False,
251	    separators=(',', ':'))`` (with no trailing newline). Returns a deep copy
252	    with keys ``at``, ``policy``, ``digest``; ``policy`` keeps every
253	    :func:`compile_rules` key order, ordering, ``when`` Unicode code point
254	    sort, and ``conflicts`` order, and ``digest`` is the lowercase 64-char
255	    hex SHA-256 of ``C``. Equal-valued inputs yield byte-identical results.
256	    """
257	    policy = compile_rules(at, rules)
258	    canonical = json.dumps(policy, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
259	    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
260	    return {"at": at, "policy": copy.deepcopy(policy), "digest": digest}
261	
262	
263	_SOURCE_ORDER = {"law": 0, "org": 1}
264

266	def _conflict_identity(conflict: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str, int, str, str, int]:
267	    """Return the six-element identity of a conflict: winner then loser."""
268	    return tuple(conflict["winner"]) + tuple(conflict["loser"])

1	# Dynamic Regulation Policy Compiler
2	
3	把版本化法规和机构规则编译为确定性的后端决策策略，面向需要可追溯决策的服务端系统。
4	
5	## 环境与启动
6	
7	需要 Python 3.12+。
8	
9	```bash
10	python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
11	uvicorn regulation_policy_compiler.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
12	pytest
13	```
14	
15	## 公开接口
16	
17	- `GET /health`：返回 `{"status":"ok"}`，用于进程健康检查。
18	- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.evaluate(at, facts, rules)`：对版本化规则做确定性求值，返回 `(decision, trace)`。
19	- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.compile_rules(at, rules)`：复用 `evaluate` 的校验、`[from,to)` 生效选取、每 `(source,id)` 取最高 `ver` 与排序，返回深副本 `{"at","rules","conflicts"}`；`conflicts` 按排序下标 `i<j` 列出结果不同且 `when` 条件可同时成立的规则对（前项为 winner）。

# Dynamic Regulation Policy Compiler

把版本化法规和机构规则编译为确定性的后端决策策略，面向需要可追溯决策的服务端系统。

## 环境与启动

需要 Python 3.12+。

```bash
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
uvicorn regulation_policy_compiler.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
pytest
```

## 公开接口

- `GET /health`：返回 `{"status":"ok"}`，用于进程健康检查。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.evaluate(at, facts, rules)`：对版本化规则做确定性求值，返回 `(decision, trace)`。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.compile_rules(at, rules)`：复用 `evaluate` 的校验、`[from,to)` 生效选取、每 `(source,id)` 取最高 `ver` 与排序，返回深副本 `{"at","rules","conflicts"}`；`conflicts` 按排序下标 `i<j` 列出结果不同且 `when` 条件可同时成立的规则对（前项为 winner）。
- `POST /rules/compile`：请求体为恰含 `at,rules` 的 JSON 对象；非法请求响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行）。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_coverage(at, fact_keys, rules)`：`fact_keys` 须为含零至十二个元素的数组，元素为非空且互不重复的字符串，结果按 Unicode 码点升序规范化；`at`、`rules` 沿用 `compile_rules` 的全部校验、有效版本选择和排序，当前入选规则的 `when` 引用 `fact_keys` 之外的键时抛 `ValueError`。按规范化键序枚举所有布尔赋值（每个键先 `false` 后 `true`），对每个赋值复用 `explain` 语义。返回深副本，顶层键序 `at,fact_keys,cases,summary`；`cases` 保持枚举顺序，项键序 `facts,explanation`；`summary` 键序 `total,decided,undecided,winners,shadowed`，计数与 `cases` 一致，`winners` 按编译规则顺序列出至少一次成为 `basis` 的 `[source,id,ver]`，`shadowed` 按同序列出当前入选却从未成为 `basis` 的规则。空 `fact_keys` 只产生 `facts={}` 的一个案例；空规则合法，该案例未决且两个身份数组为空。不访问历史或文件、不改任意层级输入；等值输入即使字典或 `fact_keys` 原顺序不同也产生逐字节一致的紧凑 JSON。
- `POST /rules/coverage`：请求体为恰含 `at,fact_keys,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、键集错误、事实键域错误或函数抛 `ValueError` 均响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_coverage_timeline(start, end, fact_keys, rules)`：`start`、`end` 须为合法 UTC 秒且 `start<=end`，`fact_keys` 的规范化（零至十二个非空互不重复字符串，按 Unicode 码点升序）同 `policy_coverage`，`rules` 校验同 `compile_rules`，任一非法抛 `ValueError` 且不改输入；任一候选时点的入选规则 `when` 引用 `fact_keys` 之外的键同样抛错。不访问历史或文件、不改任意层级输入。候选时点为 `start` 及规则中落在 `(start,end]` 的 `from` 与非空 `to`，去重升序后逐点计算 `compile_rules` 与 `policy_coverage`；首点必保留，后续仅当编译 `rules`、`conflicts` 或任一事实组合的 `decision`、`trace`、`basis`、`conflicts` 相对上一保留点变化时保留，仅策略变化而组合解释不变时也保留且 `changes` 为空。返回深副本，顶层键序 `start,end,fact_keys,points,gaps`；点键序 `at,policy,coverage,changes`，`policy`、`coverage` 分别为该时点 `compile_rules`、`policy_coverage` 的完整结果并逐层保持各自契约；首点 `changes=[]`，后续点按组合枚举顺序列出解释变化的完整 `facts`。`gaps` 按组合枚举顺序再按 `from` 升序列出 `decision` 为 `null` 的最大连续区间，项键序 `facts,from,to`；`from` 为决策丢失时点，决策恢复时 `to` 为恢复时点（不含该点），延续至末端时 `to=end`（含末端）。`start=end` 仍返回一个快照，未决定组合产生 `from`、`to` 均为 `start` 的缺口；空 `fact_keys` 只分析 `facts={}`，空规则使每个组合在全区间未决。等值输入不受规则、字典或 `fact_keys` 原顺序影响，结果容器互不共享，产生逐字节稳定的紧凑 JSON。
- `POST /rules/coverage/timeline`：请求体为恰含 `start,end,fact_keys,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、键集错误或函数抛 `ValueError` 均响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_shadow_report(at, fact_keys, rules)`：解释规则被遮蔽的原因。参数校验、有效版本选择、规则排序、事实键规范化与布尔组合枚举顺序（规范化键序、每键先 `false` 后 `true`）均沿用 `policy_coverage`，非法输入抛 `ValueError`；当前入选规则的 `when` 引用 `fact_keys` 之外的键同样抛错。不访问历史或文件、不改任意层级输入，返回深副本且不与输入共享可变容器；等值输入不受规则、字典或 `fact_keys` 原顺序影响，产生稳定键序。返回顶层键序 `at,fact_keys,total_cases,rules`；`rules` 按编译顺序包含全部入选规则，每项键序 `rule,matched,won,blockers`，`rule` 为完整规范化规则快照（`compile_rules` 的键序与 `when` 排序），`matched` 为条件成立的组合数，`won` 为成为最终 basis 的组合数。对每个匹配但未胜出的组合，以该组合的实际 basis 为阻挡者；`blockers` 按编译顺序去重，每项键序 `rule,cases,witness`，`rule` 为阻挡者的 `[source,id,ver]`，`cases` 为实际阻挡次数，`witness` 为枚举顺序中首个对应组合的完整规范化事实对象。阻挡者与当前规则 `result` 相同也记录，因为解释的是依据而非结果值；每条规则 `won` 加全部 `blockers.cases` 等于 `matched`。无规则时 `rules` 为空而 `total_cases` 仍为事实组合数；空 `fact_keys` 只分析 `facts={}`。
- `POST /rules/shadows`：请求体为恰含 `at,fact_keys,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、非对象、键集不符或函数抛 `ValueError` 均响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_attestation(at, rules)`：`at`、`rules` 校验同 `compile_rules`，任一类型、时间、规则字段、`[from,to)` 区间或重复 `(source,id,ver)` 错误均抛 `ValueError` 且不改输入。先取 `compile_rules(at,rules)` 结果 `policy`，返回深副本，顶层键序 `at,policy,digest`，`policy` 逐层保持 `compile_rules` 的全部键序、排序、`when` 键 Unicode 码点升序及 `conflicts` 顺序。令 C 为 `json.dumps(policy,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))` 的 UTF-8 字节（无换行），`digest` 为 C 的 SHA-256 小写十六进制 64 字符；相同值输入须得逐字节相同结果。
- `POST /rules/attest`：请求体为恰含 `at,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、非对象、键集错误或 `ValueError` 响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_delta(from_at, to_at, rules)`：`from_at`、`to_at` 须为合法 UTC 秒且 `from_at<=to_at`，`rules` 校验同 `compile_rules`，任一非法抛 `ValueError` 且不改输入。分别编译两时点并以 `(source,id)` 标识入选规则，返回深副本，顶层键序 `from,to,rules,conflicts`。`rules` 仅含 `added`（仅后有）、`removed`（仅前有）、`updated`（均有但完整值不同），相同者省略，按 `source` 的 `law`、`org` 顺序及 `id` Unicode 码点升序；项键序 `source,id,kind,before,after`，`before`/`after` 为对应编译规则快照或 `null`。`conflicts` 键序 `added,removed`，以 `winner` 数组后接 `loser` 数组的六元值为身份，`added` 按后时点编译冲突原序列出仅后有项，`removed` 按前时点原序列出仅前有项；冲突项键序 `winner,loser`。无差异时 `rules=[]` 且 `conflicts` 两数组均空。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_schedule(start, end, rules)`：`start`、`end` 须为合法 UTC 秒且 `start<=end`，`rules` 校验同 `compile_rules`，任一非法抛 `ValueError` 且不改输入。候选时点为 `start` 及规则中落在 `(start,end]` 的 `from` 与非空 `to`，去重升序后逐点调用 `compile_rules`；首点必保留，后续计算 `policy_delta(上一保留点时间, 当前候选时间, rules)`，仅当其 `rules=[]` 且 `conflicts` 的 `added`、`removed` 均为空时丢弃，否则保留。返回深副本，顶层键序 `start,end,points`；点键序 `at,rules,conflicts,delta`，`rules`、`conflicts` 取该时点 `compile_rules` 同名值并保持逐层契约；首点 `delta=null`，后续点 `delta` 为上述 `policy_delta` 的完整结果。
- `POST /rules/schedule`：请求体为恰含 `start,end,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、非对象、键集错误或 `ValueError` 响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.policy_schedule_attestation(start, end, rules)`：`start`、`end`、`rules` 的校验及异常同 `policy_schedule`（抛 `ValueError` 且不改输入）。令 S 为其 `policy_schedule` 结果，返回深副本，顶层键序 `start,end,root,points`；`start`、`end` 取 S，`points` 与 S.points 同序，项键序 `at,rules,conflicts,delta,previous,digest`，前四项逐层等于 S 对应点并保持键序。首项 `previous` 为 64 个 ASCII 字符 `0`，后项取前项 `digest`；令 C 为当前项仅含 `at,rules,conflicts,delta` 且按此键序执行 `json.dumps(...,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))` 所得无换行 UTF-8 字节，`digest` 为 `previous` 的 ASCII 字节紧接 C 所得 SHA-256 小写十六进制，`root` 取末项 `digest`；等值输入须逐字节相同。
- `POST /rules/schedule/attest`：请求体为恰含 `start,end,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、非对象、键集错误或 `ValueError` 响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.verify_policy_schedule_attestation(report, expected)`：纯函数校验调度哈希链报告，不访问文件、不改输入。`report` 恰含 `start,end,root,points`；`start`/`end` 为合法 UTC 秒且 `start<=end`，`root` 为 64 位小写十六进制字符串，`points` 为非空数组，逐层符合 `policy_schedule_attestation` 返回契约的精确键集、类型和值域（规则快照、`winner`/`loser` 冲突三元组及后续点完整 `policy_delta` 结构均按契约校验）；点 `at` 严格递增、落在闭区间 `[start,end]`，首点 `at=start` 且 `delta=null`，各点 `previous`/`digest` 为 64 位小写十六进制字符串。除结构校验外还做语义校验：点内 `rules` 各项在该点 `at` 落入 `[from,to)`（`to` 为空则不限）、`(source,id)` 唯一、按 source（law 先于 org）、priority 降序、from 降序、id 的 Unicode 码点升序、ver 降序精确排列；`conflicts` 须等于由该点 rules 按下标 i<j（result 不同且 when 可同时成立，前者为 winner）重建的冲突序列，缺失、伪造、重复、乱序均非法。后续点 `delta` 的 `from`/`to` 须分别等于前点/本点 `at`；`delta.rules` 须按 source（law 先于 org）、id 码点升序精确列出相邻快照的 added（前空后非空）、removed（前非空后空）、updated（两端非空且值不同），项键序 `source,id,kind,before,after` 且无重复、无遗漏；`conflicts.added` 按本点冲突原序、`conflicts.removed` 按前点冲突原序，精确等于 winner 数组接 loser 数组的六元身份差集；后续点 delta 不得三者皆空。`expected` 恰含 `start,end,root` 并同法校验；上述任一非法（含语义违规）均抛 `ValueError`。先按既有契约重建所有字典键序（规则 `when` 键按 Unicode 码点升序），再按 `policy_schedule_attestation` 定义逐点重算：首项 `previous` 为 64 个 ASCII 字符 `0`，后项取前项 `digest`；令 C 为当前点仅含 `at,rules,conflicts,delta` 且按此键序执行 `json.dumps(...,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))` 的无换行 UTF-8 字节，`digest` 为 `previous` 的 ASCII 字节紧接 C 的 SHA-256 小写十六进制。`report` 与 `expected` 的 `start`、`end` 或 `root` 不同，或链、任一 `digest`、最终 `root` 不符返回 `False`，否则返回 `True`。
- `POST /explanations`：请求体为恰含 `at,facts,rules` 的 JSON 对象（校验同 `evaluate`）；成功返回顶层键 `at,decision,trace,basis,conflicts`，其中 `basis` 为胜出规则的深副本（无匹配时为 `null`），`conflicts` 仅保留编译结果中涉及该胜出规则的项并保持原顺序。非法请求响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，不读写历史。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.decision_counterfactual(at, facts, target, rules)`：最小反事实解释，回答最少改变哪些已知事实可使最终 decision 等于 `target`；不访问历史或文件、不改任何层级的输入。`target` 为非空字符串或表示未决定的 `null`；`at`、`facts`、`rules` 沿用 `explain` 的全部校验并编译规则，`target` 类型非法或可编辑键超过十二个均抛 `ValueError`。可编辑键恰为当前入选规则 `when` 引用的键（按 Unicode 码点去重排序），其他事实保持不变；已有键可翻转布尔值或删除，缺失键可设为 `false` 或 `true`，每个键的一次变化计一步。枚举至多十二个键的三态空间（缺失、`false`、`true`），返回使最终 decision 等于 `target` 的全部最少步方案。返回深副本，顶层键序 `at,facts,target,explanation,distance,counterfactuals`；`facts` 为规范化输入（键按 Unicode 码点升序），`explanation` 为当前事实的完整 `explain` 结果；当前结果已等于 `target` 时 `distance` 为 `0` 且返回唯一零变更方案，无可达方案时 `distance` 为 `null` 且 `counterfactuals` 为空。每个方案键序 `changes,facts,explanation`：`changes` 按键的 Unicode 码点升序排列，每项依次含 `key,before,after`，缺失侧用 `null`；`facts` 为变更后规范化事实，`explanation` 为其完整 `explain` 结果。方案按键序及 `before`、`after` 的 `null`、`false`、`true` 顺序稳定排列，等值输入不受原字典顺序影响。
- `POST /decision-counterfactual`：请求体为恰含 `at,facts,target,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、非对象、键集不符或函数抛 `ValueError` 均响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}`，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史、不访问文件。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.decision_attestation(at, facts, rules)`：`at`、`facts`、`rules` 的校验同 `explain`，任一非法时间、事实类型、规则结构、区间或重复规则版本均抛 `ValueError` 且不改输入；只处理传入值，不访问历史或文件。返回深副本，顶层键序 `at,facts,explanation,policy,digest`；`facts` 为输入事实的深副本，键按 Unicode 码点升序（空对象合法）；`explanation` 为 `explain(at,facts,rules)` 的完整深副本并保持各层规范键序；`policy` 为同一时点同一规则的 `compile_rules(at,rules)` 完整深副本（含全部冲突，不省略）。令 C 为仅含前四项且按此键序执行 `json.dumps(...,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))` 所得无换行 UTF-8 字节，`digest` 为 C 的 SHA-256 小写十六进制 64 字符；同值输入无论字典原顺序如何均逐字节相同。返回值各分支不共享可变容器，调用方修改结果不影响输入或后续等值调用；空事实、空规则、无匹配决策照常产生凭证，不另设特殊错误。
- `POST /explanations/attest`：请求体为恰含 `at,facts,rules` 的 JSON 对象；解析失败、非对象、键集错误或 `ValueError` 响应 422 `{"detail":"invalid request"}` 且不产生部分凭证，成功返回 UTF-8 紧凑 JSON（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行），不读写历史，历史未配置也不影响。
- `regulation_policy_compiler.policy.verify_decision_attestation(report, expected)`：纯函数校验单时点决策凭证，不访问历史或文件、不改任何层级的输入。`report` 恰含 `at,facts,explanation,policy,digest` 并逐层符合 `decision_attestation` 返回契约；`at` 为合法 UTC 秒，`facts` 仅允许非空字符串键和布尔值（空事实合法），`digest` 为 64 位小写十六进制字符串。`policy` 恰含 `at,rules,conflicts` 且其 `at` 与凭证 `at` 一致；规则在该时点须落入 `[from,to)`（`to` 为空则不限）、每个 `(source,id)` 唯一，并按 source（law 先于 org）、priority 降序、from 降序、id 的 Unicode 码点升序、ver 降序精确排列；`conflicts` 须等于由该规则序列按下标 i<j（result 不同且 when 可同时成立，前项为 winner）完整重建的冲突序列，缺失、伪造、重复、乱序均非法。`explanation` 恰含 `at,decision,trace,basis,conflicts` 且其 `at` 与凭证 `at` 一致；以凭证 `facts` 对 `policy.rules` 按 `explain` 契约求值并整体比对——无匹配时 `decision`、`basis` 为 `null` 且 `trace`、`conflicts` 为空，有匹配时 `decision` 为排序最高匹配规则的 `result`，`trace` 列出全部匹配规则的 `id@ver`，`basis` 为该规则快照，`conflicts` 按原序保留涉及该 basis 的冲突；决策、轨迹、胜出依据与相关冲突彼此不吻合均为非法。`expected` 恰含 `at,digest`，时间与摘要格式分别沿用上述约束，不接受其他字段。任一层级的键集、类型、时间、事实、规则、冲突或解释语义非法均抛 `ValueError`；两份输入先完整通过结构与语义校验，再做任何比较，避免短路掩盖坏报告。随后按凭证契约重建规范键序（`facts` 及规则 `when` 键按 Unicode 码点升序），以仅含 `at,facts,explanation,policy`（按此键序）的紧凑 UTF-8 JSON 字节（非 ASCII 不转义、无末尾换行）重算 SHA-256 小写十六进制摘要。报告声明摘要与重算值不同，或报告的 `at`、`digest` 与 `expected` 不符返回 `False`，全部一致才返回 `True`。

128	def _record_response(record: dict[str, Any]) -> Response:

133	async def _policy_response(
134	    request: Request,
135	    keys: set[str],
136	    operation: Callable[..., Any],
137	    fields: tuple[str, ...],
138	    *,
139	    wrap_valid: bool = False,
140	) -> Response:
141	    """Shared HTTP boundary for the stateless policy endpoints.
142	
143	    Reads the request body, requires an exact key set, invokes the policy
144	    operation with the requested fields in order, maps ValueError to a 422
145	    response, and encodes the result as compact UTF-8 JSON.
146	    """
147	    try:
148	        body = json.loads(await request.body())
149	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
150	        return _invalid_request()
151	    if not isinstance(body, dict) or set(body) != keys:
152	        return _invalid_request()
153	    try:
154	        result = operation(*(body[field] for field in fields))
155	    except ValueError:
156	        return _invalid_request()
157	    if wrap_valid:
158	        result = {"valid": result}
159	    return _record_response(result)

243	    ``root`` is recomputed from the canonically ordered sub-reports using the
244	    public batch chaining algorithm: starting from 64 ASCII ``0`` characters,
245	    link each report's ``{"id","root"}`` payload. A ``previous``, ``digest``,
246	    per-report ``root``, or bundle ``root`` mismatch returns ``False``, as do
247	    differing time windows, roots, or record-id sets between ``report`` and
248	    ``expected``; otherwise the result is ``True``.
249	    """
250	    if not isinstance(report, dict) or set(report) != set(_BUNDLE_REPORT_KEYS):
251	        raise ValueError(
252	            "report must be a dict with exactly the keys start, end, root, reports"
253	        )
254	    _check_time_window(report["start"], report["end"], "report")
255	    _check_hex64(report["root"], "report.root")
256	    reports = report["reports"]
257	    if not isinstance(reports, list) or not reports:
258	        raise ValueError("report.reports must be a non-empty list")
259	
260	    # Validate every sub-report structurally (exact audit-report contract) and
261	    # confirm the canonical id ordering and bundle-wide uniqueness. Deep copies
262	    # are normalized here so the caller's objects are never modified.
263	    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
264	    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
265	    previous_id: str | None = None
266	    for index, sub in enumerate(reports):
267	        label = f"report.reports[{index}]"
268	        if not isinstance(sub, dict) or set(sub) != set(_AUDIT_REPORT_KEYS):
269	            raise ValueError(
270	                f"{label} must be a dict with exactly the keys "
271	                "id, start, end, root, entries"
272	            )
273	        record_id = sub["id"]
274	        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"{label}.id")
275	        if record_id in seen_ids:
276	            raise ValueError(f"report.reports contains a duplicate id: {record_id!r}")
277	        if previous_id is not None and not previous_id < record_id:
278	            raise ValueError(
279	                "report.reports must be ordered by id in ascending Unicode "
280	                "code point order"
281	            )
282	        if sub["start"] != report["start"] or sub["end"] != report["end"]:
283	            raise ValueError(f"{label} time window must equal the bundle window")
284	        _check_hex64(sub["root"], f"{label}.root")
285	        entries = sub["entries"]
286	        if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
287	            raise ValueError(f"{label}.entries must be a non-empty list")
288	        normalized_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
289	        previous_at: str | None = None
290	        for entry_index, entry in enumerate(entries):
291	            normalized_entries.append(
292	                _validate_audit_entry(entry, entry_index)
293	            )
294	            at = entry["at"]
295	            if previous_at is not None and at <= previous_at:
296	                raise ValueError(f"{label}.entries must be strictly increasing in at")
297	            if not report["start"] <= at <= report["end"]:
298	                raise ValueError(
299	                    f"{label}.entries[{entry_index}].at lies outside [start, end]"
300	                )
301	            previous_at = at
302	        normalized.append(
303	            {
304	                "id": record_id,
305	                "start": sub["start"],
306	                "end": sub["end"],
307	                "root": sub["root"],
308	                "entries": normalized_entries,
309	            }
310	        )
311	        seen_ids.add(record_id)
312	        previous_id = record_id
313	
314	    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != set(_BUNDLE_EXPECTED_KEYS):
315	        raise ValueError(
316	            "expected must be a dict with exactly the keys "
317	            "start, end, root, record_ids"
318	        )
319	    _check_time_window(expected["start"], expected["end"], "expected")
320	    _check_hex64(expected["root"], "expected.root")
321	    record_ids = expected["record_ids"]
322	    if not isinstance(record_ids, list) or not record_ids:
323	        raise ValueError("expected.record_ids must be a non-empty list")
324	    expected_ids: set[str] = set()
325	    for index, record_id in enumerate(record_ids):
326	        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"expected.record_ids[{index}]")
327	        if record_id in expected_ids:
328	            raise ValueError("expected.record_ids must not contain duplicates")
329	        expected_ids.add(record_id)
330	
331	    # All structural checks have passed; only now compare against expected.
332	    if expected["start"] != report["start"] or expected["end"] != report["end"]:
333	        return False
334	    if expected["root"] != report["root"]:
335	        return False
336	    if expected_ids != seen_ids:
337	        return False
338	
339	    # Recompute each record's chain rather than trusting declared digests.
340	    recomputed_roots: list[str] = []
341	    for sub in normalized:
342	        previous = _AUDIT_GENESIS
343	        for entry in sub["entries"]:

346	            if entry["digest"] != _audit_digest(previous, entry):
347	                return False
348	            previous = entry["digest"]
349	        if sub["root"] != previous:

351	        recomputed_roots.append(previous)

353	    # Recompute the batch root from the canonically ordered sub-reports.
354	    bundle_root = _AUDIT_GENESIS
355	    for sub, recomputed_root in zip(normalized, recomputed_roots):
356	        bundle_root = _bundle_link(bundle_root, sub["id"], recomputed_root)

360	class DecisionHistory:
361	    """A JSON-file-backed store of decision records.
362	
363	    The file is UTF-8 compact JSON (a single trailing newline) holding only a
364	    ``records`` array sorted by ``(id, at)`` in Unicode code point order.
365	    """
366	
367	    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
368	        if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
369	            raise ValueError("path must be a non-empty string")
370	        self._path = path
371	        self._records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
372	        if os.path.exists(path):
373	            self._records = self._load()
374	        else:
375	            self._persist()
376	
377	    def _load(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
378	        with open(self._path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
379	            try:
380	                raw = json.load(handle)
381	            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
382	                raise ValueError(f"{self._path!r} does not contain valid JSON") from exc
383	        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"records"}:
384	            raise ValueError(f"{self._path!r} must contain only a records array")
385	        records = raw["records"]
386	        if not isinstance(records, list):
387	            raise ValueError(f"{self._path!r}: records must be an array")
388	        return [_validate_entry(entry, index) for index, entry in enumerate(records)]
389	
390	    def _persist(self) -> None:
391	        data = _dump(self._records)
392	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self._path))
393	        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=directory, prefix=".decision-history-")
394	        try:
395	            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
396	                handle.write(data)
397	                handle.flush()
398	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
399	            os.replace(tmp, self._path)
400	        except OSError:
401	            try:
402	                os.unlink(tmp)
403	            except OSError:
404	                pass
405	            raise
406	
407	    def record(
408	        self,
409	        record_id: str,
410	        at: str,
411	        facts: dict[str, bool],
412	        rules: list[dict[str, Any]],
413	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
414	        """Evaluate ``rules`` and persist the outcome under ``(record_id, at)``."""
415	        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
416	        matched = _matched_rules(at, facts, rules)
417	        if any(entry["id"] == record_id and entry["at"] == at for entry in self._records):
418	            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record for (record_id, at): ({record_id!r}, {at!r})")
419	        if matched:
420	            decision: str | None = matched[0]["result"]
421	            trace = [f"{rule['id']}@{rule['ver']}" for rule in matched]
422	            basis: dict[str, Any] | None = _snapshot_basis(matched[0])
423	        else:
424	            decision = None
425	            trace = []
426	            basis = None
427	        entry = {"id": record_id, "at": at, "decision": decision, "trace": trace, "basis": basis}
428	        self._records.append(entry)
429	        try:
430	            self._persist()
431	        except OSError:
432	            self._records.remove(entry)
433	            raise
434	        return copy.deepcopy(entry)
435	
436	    def replay(self, record_id: str, at: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
437	        """Return a copy of the most recent record for ``record_id`` at or before ``at``."""
438	        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
439	        _check_time(at, "at")
440	        best: dict[str, Any] | None = None
441	        for entry in self._records:
442	            if entry["id"] == record_id and entry["at"] <= at:
443	                if best is None or entry["at"] > best["at"]:
444	                    best = entry
445	        if best is None:
446	            raise KeyError(record_id)
447	        return copy.deepcopy(best)

449	    def evolution(self, record_id: str, start: str, end: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
450	        """Return stored snapshots for ``record_id`` within the closed ``[start, end]``.
451	
452	        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed, written,
453	        or otherwise mutated. ``record_id`` must be a non-empty string and
454	        ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds with ``start <= end``; otherwise
455	        ``ValueError`` is raised. Matching records are returned in ascending
456	        ``at`` order; when none match, ``KeyError`` is raised. The result is a
457	        deep copy with keys ``id, start, end, entries``; each entry has keys
458	        ``at, decision, trace, basis, changes``, where ``changes`` lists, in
459	        the order ``decision, trace, basis``, the fields differing from the
460	        previous entry (the first entry's ``changes`` is ``[]``).
461	        """

463	        _check_time(start, "start")
464	        _check_time(end, "end")
465	        if start > end:
466	            raise ValueError(f"start must not be after end: {start!r} > {end!r}")
467	        matched = [
468	            entry
469	            for entry in self._records
470	            if entry["id"] == record_id and start <= entry["at"] <= end
471	        ]
472	        if not matched:
473	            raise KeyError(record_id)
474	        matched.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["at"])
475	        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
476	        previous: dict[str, Any] | None = None
477	        for entry in matched:
478	            if previous is None:
479	                changes: list[str] = []
480	            else:
481	                changes = [
482	                    field
483	                    for field in _EVOLUTION_FIELDS
484	                    if entry[field] != previous[field]
485	                ]
486	            entries.append(
487	                {
488	                    "at": entry["at"],
489	                    "decision": copy.deepcopy(entry["decision"]),
490	                    "trace": copy.deepcopy(entry["trace"]),
491	                    "basis": copy.deepcopy(entry["basis"]),
492	                    "changes": changes,
493	                }
494	            )
495	            previous = entry
496	        return {"id": record_id, "start": start, "end": end, "entries": entries}

498	    def audit(self, record_id: str, start: str, end: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
499	        """Return a hash-chained audit trail for ``record_id`` over ``[start, end]``.
500	
501	        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed, written,
502	        or otherwise mutated. ``record_id`` must be a non-empty string and
503	        ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds with ``start <= end``; otherwise
504	        ``ValueError`` is raised. Matching records are returned in ascending
505	        ``at`` order; when none match, ``KeyError`` is raised. The result is a
506	        deep copy with keys ``id, start, end, root, entries``; each entry has
507	        keys ``at, decision, trace, basis, previous, digest``, the first four
508	        following the record contract.
509	
510	        Let ``C`` be the UTF-8 compact JSON bytes (non-ASCII unescaped, no
511	        trailing newline) of the current entry restricted to
512	        ``at, decision, trace, basis`` in that key order. The first entry's
513	        ``previous`` is 64 ASCII ``0`` characters; every later entry's
514	        ``previous`` is the preceding entry's ``digest``. ``digest`` is the
515	        lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of ``previous``'s ASCII bytes immediately
516	        followed by ``C``; ``root`` is the last entry's ``digest``.
517	        """
518	        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
519	        _check_time(start, "start")
520	        _check_time(end, "end")
521	        if start > end:
522	            raise ValueError(f"start must not be after end: {start!r} > {end!r}")
523	        matched = [
524	            entry
525	            for entry in self._records
526	            if entry["id"] == record_id and start <= entry["at"] <= end
527	        ]
528	        if not matched:
529	            raise KeyError(record_id)
530	        matched.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["at"])
531	        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
532	        previous = _AUDIT_GENESIS
533	        for entry in matched:
534	            digest = _audit_digest(previous, entry)
535	            entries.append(
536	                {
537	                    "at": entry["at"],
538	                    "decision": copy.deepcopy(entry["decision"]),
539	                    "trace": copy.deepcopy(entry["trace"]),
540	                    "basis": copy.deepcopy(entry["basis"]),
541	                    "previous": previous,
542	                    "digest": digest,
543	                }
544	            )
545	            previous = digest
546	        return {
547	            "id": record_id,
548	            "start": start,
549	            "end": end,
550	            "root": previous,
551	            "entries": entries,
552	        }

554	    def audit_bundle(self, record_ids: Any, start: str, end: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
555	        """Return one hash-chained bundle of audit reports over ``[start, end]``.
556	
557	        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed,
558	        written, or otherwise mutated. ``record_ids`` must be a non-empty list
559	        of unique non-empty strings and ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds
560	        with ``start <= end``; otherwise ``ValueError`` is raised and the
561	        inputs are left untouched. Each id is audited once in ascending
562	        Unicode code point order; if any id has no record in the closed
563	        interval, ``KeyError`` is raised and no partial result is returned.
564	
565	        The result is a deep copy with keys ``start, end, root, reports``;
566	        ``reports`` holds each id's complete audit result in that same order,
567	        preserving the per-report contract. Let ``h0`` be 64 ASCII ``0``
568	        characters and ``Pi`` the UTF-8 compact JSON bytes (non-ASCII
569	        unescaped, no trailing newline) of the i-th report restricted to
570	        ``id, root`` in that key order. ``hi`` is the lowercase hexadecimal
571	        SHA-256 of ``h{i-1}``'s ASCII bytes immediately followed by ``Pi``;
572	        the bundle ``root`` is ``hn``.
573	        """
574	        if not isinstance(record_ids, list) or not record_ids:
575	            raise ValueError("record_ids must be a non-empty list of record id strings")
576	        seen: set[str] = set()
577	        for index, record_id in enumerate(record_ids):
578	            _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"record_ids[{index}]")
579	            if record_id in seen:
580	                raise ValueError(
581	                    f"record_ids must not contain duplicates: {record_id!r}"
582	                )
583	            seen.add(record_id)
584	        _check_time(start, "start")
585	        _check_time(end, "end")
586	        if start > end:
587	            raise ValueError(f"start must not be after end: {start!r} > {end!r}")
588	        reports = [
589	            self.audit(record_id, start, end)
590	            for record_id in sorted(record_ids)
591	        ]
592	        root = _AUDIT_GENESIS
593	        for report in reports:
594	            payload = json.dumps(
595	                {"id": report["id"], "root": report["root"]},
596	                ensure_ascii=False,
597	                separators=(",", ":"),
598	            )
599	            root = hashlib.sha256(
600	                root.encode("ascii") + payload.encode("utf-8")
601	            ).hexdigest()
602	        return copy.deepcopy(
603	            {"start": start, "end": end, "root": root, "reports": reports}
604	        )

606	    def replay_diff(
607	        self, record_ids: Any, from_at: str, to_at: str
608	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
609	        """Compare replay results for ``record_ids`` between two cutoffs.
610	
611	        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed,
612	        written, or otherwise mutated. ``record_ids`` must be a non-empty list
613	        of unique non-empty strings and ``from_at``/``to_at`` valid UTC
614	        seconds with ``from_at <= to_at``; otherwise ``ValueError`` is raised.
615	        Each id is compared once in ascending Unicode code point order; if any
616	        id has no record at or before ``to_at``, ``KeyError`` is raised and no
617	        partial result is returned. An id with no record at or before
618	        ``from_at`` is an introduction rather than an error.

621	        each entry has keys ``id, kind, before, after, changes``, where
622	        ``before``/``after`` are deep copies of the most recent record at or
623	        before the respective cutoff in the replay record contract (``before``
624	        is ``null`` for an introduction; ``after`` always exists). Entries with
625	        both sides present compare only ``decision, trace, basis`` (in that
626	        order): ``kind`` is ``changed`` when any differs and ``unchanged``
627	        otherwise, so records at different ``at`` with equal compared fields
628	        are still ``unchanged``. ``summary`` has keys
629	        ``total, introduced, changed, unchanged`` with counts matching
630	        ``entries``. Caller order never affects the result.
631	        """
632	        if not isinstance(record_ids, list) or not record_ids:
633	            raise ValueError("record_ids must be a non-empty list of record id strings")
634	        seen: set[str] = set()
635	        for index, record_id in enumerate(record_ids):
636	            _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"record_ids[{index}]")
637	            if record_id in seen:
638	                raise ValueError(
639	                    f"record_ids must not contain duplicates: {record_id!r}"
640	                )
641	            seen.add(record_id)
642	        _check_time(from_at, "from_at")
643	        _check_time(to_at, "to_at")
644	        if from_at > to_at:
645	            raise ValueError(
646	                f"from_at must not be after to_at: {from_at!r} > {to_at!r}"
647	            )

650	            best: dict[str, Any] | None = None

653	                    if best is None or entry["at"] > best["at"]:

655	            return best
656	
657	        # Resolve every pair first; a missing after-snapshot fails the whole
658	        # diff before any result is built.
659	        snapshots: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None, dict[str, Any]]] = []
660	        for record_id in sorted(seen):
661	            after = latest(record_id, to_at)
662	            if after is None:
663	                raise KeyError(record_id)

667	        introduced = changed = unchanged = 0

673	            else:
674	                changes = [
675	                    field
676	                    for field in _EVOLUTION_FIELDS
677	                    if before[field] != after[field]

680	                    kind = "changed"
681	                    changed += 1
682	                else:
683	                    kind = "unchanged"
684	                    unchanged += 1

686	                {
687	                    "id": record_id,
688	                    "kind": kind,
689	                    "before": copy.deepcopy(before),
690	                    "after": copy.deepcopy(after),
691	                    "changes": changes,
692	                }
693	            )
694	        return {
695	            "from": from_at,
696	            "to": to_at,
697	            "entries": entries,
698	            "summary": {

700	                "introduced": introduced,
701	                "changed": changed,
702	                "unchanged": unchanged,

"""Persistent, replayable history of policy decisions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import tempfile
from typing import Any

from .policy import _check_non_empty_str, _check_time, _matched_rules, _validate_rules

_RECORD_KEYS = ("id", "at", "decision", "trace", "basis")
_BASIS_KEYS = ("id", "ver", "source", "priority", "from", "to", "when", "result")
_EVOLUTION_FIELDS = ("decision", "trace", "basis")
_AUDIT_PAYLOAD_KEYS = ("at", "decision", "trace", "basis")
_AUDIT_ENTRY_KEYS = ("at", "decision", "trace", "basis", "previous", "digest")
_AUDIT_REPORT_KEYS = ("id", "start", "end", "root", "entries")
_AUDIT_EXPECTED_KEYS = ("id", "start", "end", "root")
_BUNDLE_REPORT_KEYS = ("start", "end", "root", "reports")
_BUNDLE_EXPECTED_KEYS = ("start", "end", "root", "record_ids")
_AUDIT_GENESIS = "0" * 64
_HEX_DIGITS = frozenset("0123456789abcdef")


def _check_trace_entry(value: Any, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string of the form id@ver")
    rule_id, sep, ver = value.rpartition("@")
    if not sep or not rule_id or not ver.isdigit() or int(ver) < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string of the form id@ver")
    return value


def _validate_entry(entry: Any, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    field = f"records[{index}]"
    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != set(_RECORD_KEYS):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{field} must be a dict with exactly the keys id, at, decision, trace, basis"
        )
    _check_non_empty_str(entry["id"], f"{field}.id")
    _check_time(entry["at"], f"{field}.at")
    decision = entry["decision"]
    if decision is not None and not isinstance(decision, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field}.decision must be a string or null")
    trace = entry["trace"]
    if not isinstance(trace, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{field}.trace must be a list of id@ver strings")
    for position, item in enumerate(trace):
        _check_trace_entry(item, f"{field}.trace[{position}]")
    basis = entry["basis"]
    if basis is not None:
        try:
            _validate_rules([basis])
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"{field}.basis is not a valid rule: {exc}") from exc
        # Normalize the snapshot to the canonical key order in memory so every
        # history method returns the same basis shape; the file is not rewritten.
        entry["basis"] = _snapshot_basis(basis)
    return entry


def _snapshot_basis(rule: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    when = rule["when"]
    if when is not None:
        when = {key: when[key] for key in sorted(when)}
    return {
        "id": rule["id"],
        "ver": rule["ver"],
        "source": rule["source"],
        "priority": rule["priority"],
        "from": rule["from"],
        "to": rule["to"],
        "when": when,
        "result": rule["result"],
    }


def _dump(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bytes:
    ordered = sorted(records, key=lambda entry: (entry["id"], entry["at"]))
    text = json.dumps({"records": ordered}, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    return (text + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def _audit_digest(previous: str, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    payload = {key: entry[key] for key in _AUDIT_PAYLOAD_KEYS}
    content = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(previous.encode("ascii") + content.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _check_hex64(value: Any, field: str) -> str:
    if (
        not isinstance(value, str)
        or len(value) != 64
        or any(char not in _HEX_DIGITS for char in value)
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters")
    return value


def _check_time_window(start: Any, end: Any, field: str) -> None:
    _check_time(start, f"{field}.start")
    _check_time(end, f"{field}.end")
    if start > end:
        raise ValueError(f"{field}.start must not be after {field}.end")


def _validate_audit_entry(entry: Any, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate one audit entry and return a normalized deep copy of it."""
    field = f"entries[{index}]"
    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != set(_AUDIT_ENTRY_KEYS):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{field} must be a dict with exactly the keys "
            "at, decision, trace, basis, previous, digest"
        )
    _check_time(entry["at"], f"{field}.at")
    decision = entry["decision"]
    if decision is not None and not isinstance(decision, str):
        raise ValueError(f"{field}.decision must be a string or null")
    trace = entry["trace"]
    if not isinstance(trace, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{field}.trace must be a list of id@ver strings")
    for position, item in enumerate(trace):
        _check_trace_entry(item, f"{field}.trace[{position}]")
    basis = entry["basis"]
    if basis is not None:
        try:
            _validate_rules([basis])
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"{field}.basis is not a valid rule: {exc}") from exc
        basis = _snapshot_basis(basis)
    _check_hex64(entry["previous"], f"{field}.previous")
    _check_hex64(entry["digest"], f"{field}.digest")
    return {
        "at": entry["at"],
        "decision": copy.deepcopy(decision),
        "trace": copy.deepcopy(trace),
        "basis": basis,
        "previous": entry["previous"],
        "digest": entry["digest"],
    }


def verify_audit(report: Any, expected: Any) -> bool:
    """Verify an audit report against an expected summary by recomputation.

    ``report`` must be a dict with exactly the keys ``id, start, end, root,
    entries``; ``id`` a non-empty string, ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds
    with ``start <= end``, and ``entries`` a non-empty list whose ``at``
    values are strictly increasing and lie in the closed interval
    ``[start, end]``. Each entry must have exactly the keys ``at, decision,
    trace, basis, previous, digest``; the first four follow the audit entry
    contract, and ``previous``/``digest`` must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal
    characters. ``expected`` must have exactly the keys ``id, start, end,
    root`` and is validated the same way. Any violation raises ``ValueError``.

    Returns ``False`` when the shared fields differ between ``report`` and
    ``expected``. Otherwise each entry's ``basis`` (and its ``when`` keys) is
    normalized to the canonical key order and the chain is recomputed exactly
    as :meth:`DecisionHistory.audit` defines it: the first ``previous`` is 64
    ASCII ``0`` characters, every later ``previous`` is the preceding entry's
    ``digest``, and ``digest`` is the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of
    ``previous``'s ASCII bytes immediately followed by ``C``. Any chain,
    digest, or root mismatch returns ``False``; otherwise ``True``.

    The function touches neither history nor files and does not mutate its
    inputs.
    """
    if not isinstance(report, dict) or set(report) != set(_AUDIT_REPORT_KEYS):
        raise ValueError(
            "report must be a dict with exactly the keys id, start, end, root, entries"
        )
    _check_non_empty_str(report["id"], "report.id")
    _check_time_window(report["start"], report["end"], "report")
    _check_hex64(report["root"], "report.root")
    entries = report["entries"]
    if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
        raise ValueError("report.entries must be a non-empty list")
    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    previous_at: str | None = None
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
        normalized.append(_validate_audit_entry(entry, index))
        at = entry["at"]
        if previous_at is not None and at <= previous_at:
            raise ValueError("report.entries must be strictly increasing in at")
        if not report["start"] <= at <= report["end"]:
            raise ValueError(f"entries[{index}].at lies outside [start, end]")
        previous_at = at
    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != set(_AUDIT_EXPECTED_KEYS):
        raise ValueError(
            "expected must be a dict with exactly the keys id, start, end, root"
        )
    _check_non_empty_str(expected["id"], "expected.id")
    _check_time_window(expected["start"], expected["end"], "expected")
    _check_hex64(expected["root"], "expected.root")
    for key in _AUDIT_EXPECTED_KEYS:
        if report[key] != expected[key]:
            return False
    previous = _AUDIT_GENESIS
    for entry in normalized:
        if entry["previous"] != previous:
            return False
        if entry["digest"] != _audit_digest(previous, entry):
            return False
        previous = entry["digest"]
    return report["root"] == previous


def _bundle_link(previous: str, record_id: str, report_root: str) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(
        {"id": record_id, "root": report_root},
        ensure_ascii=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(
        previous.encode("ascii") + payload.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()


def verify_audit_bundle(report: Any, expected: Any) -> bool:
    """Verify a batch audit bundle against an expected summary.

    Pure function: it touches neither history nor files and never mutates its
    inputs. ``report`` must be a dict with exactly the keys
    ``start, end, root, reports``; ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds with
    ``start <= end`` and ``root`` a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string.
    ``reports`` must be a non-empty list of audit reports. Each sub-report must
    conform exactly to the :func:`verify_audit` report contract: its ``id`` is
    a non-empty string unique within the bundle, its time window equals the
    bundle window, and its entries lie in that closed interval in strictly
    increasing order. The sub-reports must be ordered by their ``id`` in
    ascending Unicode code point order; duplicate ids or misordered reports are
    illegal. ``expected`` must have exactly the keys
    ``start, end, root, record_ids``; ``record_ids`` must be a non-empty list of
    unique non-empty strings (caller order is arbitrary; comparison is by code
    point). Any key-set, type, time, id, or digest-format violation at any
    level raises ``ValueError``.

    Structural validation completes before any comparison. Afterwards each
    record's chain is recomputed with the same semantics as
    :func:`verify_audit` (never trusting the declared digests), and the bundle
    ``root`` is recomputed from the canonically ordered sub-reports using the
    public batch chaining algorithm: starting from 64 ASCII ``0`` characters,
    link each report's ``{"id","root"}`` payload. A ``previous``, ``digest``,
    per-report ``root``, or bundle ``root`` mismatch returns ``False``, as do
    differing time windows, roots, or record-id sets between ``report`` and
    ``expected``; otherwise the result is ``True``.
    """
    if not isinstance(report, dict) or set(report) != set(_BUNDLE_REPORT_KEYS):
        raise ValueError(
            "report must be a dict with exactly the keys start, end, root, reports"
        )
    _check_time_window(report["start"], report["end"], "report")
    _check_hex64(report["root"], "report.root")
    reports = report["reports"]
    if not isinstance(reports, list) or not reports:
        raise ValueError("report.reports must be a non-empty list")

    # Validate every sub-report structurally (exact audit-report contract) and
    # confirm the canonical id ordering and bundle-wide uniqueness. Deep copies
    # are normalized here so the caller's objects are never modified.
    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
    previous_id: str | None = None
    for index, sub in enumerate(reports):
        label = f"report.reports[{index}]"
        if not isinstance(sub, dict) or set(sub) != set(_AUDIT_REPORT_KEYS):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{label} must be a dict with exactly the keys "
                "id, start, end, root, entries"
            )
        record_id = sub["id"]
        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"{label}.id")
        if record_id in seen_ids:
            raise ValueError(f"report.reports contains a duplicate id: {record_id!r}")
        if previous_id is not None and not previous_id < record_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "report.reports must be ordered by id in ascending Unicode "
                "code point order"
            )
        if sub["start"] != report["start"] or sub["end"] != report["end"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{label} time window must equal the bundle window")
        _check_hex64(sub["root"], f"{label}.root")
        entries = sub["entries"]
        if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
            raise ValueError(f"{label}.entries must be a non-empty list")
        normalized_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        previous_at: str | None = None
        for entry_index, entry in enumerate(entries):
            normalized_entries.append(
                _validate_audit_entry(entry, entry_index)
            )
            at = entry["at"]
            if previous_at is not None and at <= previous_at:
                raise ValueError(f"{label}.entries must be strictly increasing in at")
            if not report["start"] <= at <= report["end"]:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{label}.entries[{entry_index}].at lies outside [start, end]"
                )
            previous_at = at
        normalized.append(
            {
                "id": record_id,
                "start": sub["start"],
                "end": sub["end"],
                "root": sub["root"],
                "entries": normalized_entries,
            }
        )
        seen_ids.add(record_id)
        previous_id = record_id

    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != set(_BUNDLE_EXPECTED_KEYS):
        raise ValueError(
            "expected must be a dict with exactly the keys "
            "start, end, root, record_ids"
        )
    _check_time_window(expected["start"], expected["end"], "expected")
    _check_hex64(expected["root"], "expected.root")
    record_ids = expected["record_ids"]
    if not isinstance(record_ids, list) or not record_ids:
        raise ValueError("expected.record_ids must be a non-empty list")
    expected_ids: set[str] = set()
    for index, record_id in enumerate(record_ids):
        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"expected.record_ids[{index}]")
        if record_id in expected_ids:
            raise ValueError("expected.record_ids must not contain duplicates")
        expected_ids.add(record_id)

    # All structural checks have passed; only now compare against expected.
    if expected["start"] != report["start"] or expected["end"] != report["end"]:
        return False
    if expected["root"] != report["root"]:
        return False
    if expected_ids != seen_ids:
        return False

    # Recompute each record's chain rather than trusting declared digests.
    recomputed_roots: list[str] = []
    for sub in normalized:
        previous = _AUDIT_GENESIS
        for entry in sub["entries"]:
            if entry["previous"] != previous:
                return False
            if entry["digest"] != _audit_digest(previous, entry):
                return False
            previous = entry["digest"]
        if sub["root"] != previous:
            return False
        recomputed_roots.append(previous)

    # Recompute the batch root from the canonically ordered sub-reports.
    bundle_root = _AUDIT_GENESIS
    for sub, recomputed_root in zip(normalized, recomputed_roots):
        bundle_root = _bundle_link(bundle_root, sub["id"], recomputed_root)
    return report["root"] == bundle_root


class DecisionHistory:
    """A JSON-file-backed store of decision records.

    The file is UTF-8 compact JSON (a single trailing newline) holding only a
    ``records`` array sorted by ``(id, at)`` in Unicode code point order.
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
        if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
            raise ValueError("path must be a non-empty string")
        self._path = path
        self._records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        if os.path.exists(path):
            self._records = self._load()
        else:
            self._persist()

    def _load(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with open(self._path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            try:
                raw = json.load(handle)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"{self._path!r} does not contain valid JSON") from exc
        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"records"}:
            raise ValueError(f"{self._path!r} must contain only a records array")
        records = raw["records"]
        if not isinstance(records, list):
            raise ValueError(f"{self._path!r}: records must be an array")
        return [_validate_entry(entry, index) for index, entry in enumerate(records)]

    def _persist(self) -> None:
        data = _dump(self._records)
        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self._path))
        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=directory, prefix=".decision-history-")
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(data)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
            os.replace(tmp, self._path)
        except OSError:
            try:
                os.unlink(tmp)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise

    def record(
        self,
        record_id: str,
        at: str,
        facts: dict[str, bool],
        rules: list[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Evaluate ``rules`` and persist the outcome under ``(record_id, at)``."""
        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
        matched = _matched_rules(at, facts, rules)
        if any(entry["id"] == record_id and entry["at"] == at for entry in self._records):
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record for (record_id, at): ({record_id!r}, {at!r})")
        if matched:
            decision: str | None = matched[0]["result"]
            trace = [f"{rule['id']}@{rule['ver']}" for rule in matched]
            basis: dict[str, Any] | None = _snapshot_basis(matched[0])
        else:
            decision = None
            trace = []
            basis = None
        entry = {"id": record_id, "at": at, "decision": decision, "trace": trace, "basis": basis}
        self._records.append(entry)
        try:
            self._persist()
        except OSError:
            self._records.remove(entry)
            raise
        return copy.deepcopy(entry)

    def replay(self, record_id: str, at: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a copy of the most recent record for ``record_id`` at or before ``at``."""
        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
        _check_time(at, "at")
        best: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        for entry in self._records:
            if entry["id"] == record_id and entry["at"] <= at:
                if best is None or entry["at"] > best["at"]:
                    best = entry
        if best is None:
            raise KeyError(record_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(best)

    def evolution(self, record_id: str, start: str, end: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return stored snapshots for ``record_id`` within the closed ``[start, end]``.

        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed, written,
        or otherwise mutated. ``record_id`` must be a non-empty string and
        ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds with ``start <= end``; otherwise
        ``ValueError`` is raised. Matching records are returned in ascending
        ``at`` order; when none match, ``KeyError`` is raised. The result is a
        deep copy with keys ``id, start, end, entries``; each entry has keys
        ``at, decision, trace, basis, changes``, where ``changes`` lists, in
        the order ``decision, trace, basis``, the fields differing from the
        previous entry (the first entry's ``changes`` is ``[]``).
        """
        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
        _check_time(start, "start")
        _check_time(end, "end")
        if start > end:
            raise ValueError(f"start must not be after end: {start!r} > {end!r}")
        matched = [
            entry
            for entry in self._records
            if entry["id"] == record_id and start <= entry["at"] <= end
        ]
        if not matched:
            raise KeyError(record_id)
        matched.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["at"])
        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        previous: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        for entry in matched:
            if previous is None:
                changes: list[str] = []
            else:
                changes = [
                    field
                    for field in _EVOLUTION_FIELDS
                    if entry[field] != previous[field]
                ]
            entries.append(
                {
                    "at": entry["at"],
                    "decision": copy.deepcopy(entry["decision"]),
                    "trace": copy.deepcopy(entry["trace"]),
                    "basis": copy.deepcopy(entry["basis"]),
                    "changes": changes,
                }
            )
            previous = entry
        return {"id": record_id, "start": start, "end": end, "entries": entries}

    def audit(self, record_id: str, start: str, end: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a hash-chained audit trail for ``record_id`` over ``[start, end]``.

        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed, written,
        or otherwise mutated. ``record_id`` must be a non-empty string and
        ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds with ``start <= end``; otherwise
        ``ValueError`` is raised. Matching records are returned in ascending
        ``at`` order; when none match, ``KeyError`` is raised. The result is a
        deep copy with keys ``id, start, end, root, entries``; each entry has
        keys ``at, decision, trace, basis, previous, digest``, the first four
        following the record contract.

        Let ``C`` be the UTF-8 compact JSON bytes (non-ASCII unescaped, no
        trailing newline) of the current entry restricted to
        ``at, decision, trace, basis`` in that key order. The first entry's
        ``previous`` is 64 ASCII ``0`` characters; every later entry's
        ``previous`` is the preceding entry's ``digest``. ``digest`` is the
        lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of ``previous``'s ASCII bytes immediately
        followed by ``C``; ``root`` is the last entry's ``digest``.
        """
        _check_non_empty_str(record_id, "record_id")
        _check_time(start, "start")
        _check_time(end, "end")
        if start > end:
            raise ValueError(f"start must not be after end: {start!r} > {end!r}")
        matched = [
            entry
            for entry in self._records
            if entry["id"] == record_id and start <= entry["at"] <= end
        ]
        if not matched:
            raise KeyError(record_id)
        matched.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["at"])
        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        previous = _AUDIT_GENESIS
        for entry in matched:
            digest = _audit_digest(previous, entry)
            entries.append(
                {
                    "at": entry["at"],
                    "decision": copy.deepcopy(entry["decision"]),
                    "trace": copy.deepcopy(entry["trace"]),
                    "basis": copy.deepcopy(entry["basis"]),
                    "previous": previous,
                    "digest": digest,
                }
            )
            previous = digest
        return {
            "id": record_id,
            "start": start,
            "end": end,
            "root": previous,
            "entries": entries,
        }

    def audit_bundle(self, record_ids: Any, start: str, end: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return one hash-chained bundle of audit reports over ``[start, end]``.

        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed,
        written, or otherwise mutated. ``record_ids`` must be a non-empty list
        of unique non-empty strings and ``start``/``end`` valid UTC seconds
        with ``start <= end``; otherwise ``ValueError`` is raised and the
        inputs are left untouched. Each id is audited once in ascending
        Unicode code point order; if any id has no record in the closed
        interval, ``KeyError`` is raised and no partial result is returned.

        The result is a deep copy with keys ``start, end, root, reports``;
        ``reports`` holds each id's complete audit result in that same order,
        preserving the per-report contract. Let ``h0`` be 64 ASCII ``0``
        characters and ``Pi`` the UTF-8 compact JSON bytes (non-ASCII
        unescaped, no trailing newline) of the i-th report restricted to
        ``id, root`` in that key order. ``hi`` is the lowercase hexadecimal
        SHA-256 of ``h{i-1}``'s ASCII bytes immediately followed by ``Pi``;
        the bundle ``root`` is ``hn``.
        """
        if not isinstance(record_ids, list) or not record_ids:
            raise ValueError("record_ids must be a non-empty list of record id strings")
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for index, record_id in enumerate(record_ids):
            _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"record_ids[{index}]")
            if record_id in seen:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"record_ids must not contain duplicates: {record_id!r}"
                )
            seen.add(record_id)
        _check_time(start, "start")
        _check_time(end, "end")
        if start > end:
            raise ValueError(f"start must not be after end: {start!r} > {end!r}")
        reports = [
            self.audit(record_id, start, end)
            for record_id in sorted(record_ids)
        ]
        root = _AUDIT_GENESIS
        for report in reports:
            payload = json.dumps(
                {"id": report["id"], "root": report["root"]},
                ensure_ascii=False,
                separators=(",", ":"),
            )
            root = hashlib.sha256(
                root.encode("ascii") + payload.encode("utf-8")
            ).hexdigest()
        return copy.deepcopy(
            {"start": start, "end": end, "root": root, "reports": reports}
        )

    def replay_diff(
        self, record_ids: Any, from_at: str, to_at: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Compare replay results for ``record_ids`` between two cutoffs.

        Only already-persisted records are read; nothing is recomputed,
        written, or otherwise mutated. ``record_ids`` must be a non-empty list
        of unique non-empty strings and ``from_at``/``to_at`` valid UTC
        seconds with ``from_at <= to_at``; otherwise ``ValueError`` is raised.
        Each id is compared once in ascending Unicode code point order; if any
        id has no record at or before ``to_at``, ``KeyError`` is raised and no
        partial result is returned. An id with no record at or before
        ``from_at`` is an introduction rather than an error.

        The result is a deep copy with keys ``from, to, entries, summary``;
        each entry has keys ``id, kind, before, after, changes``, where
        ``before``/``after`` are deep copies of the most recent record at or
        before the respective cutoff in the replay record contract (``before``
        is ``null`` for an introduction; ``after`` always exists). Entries with
        both sides present compare only ``decision, trace, basis`` (in that
        order): ``kind`` is ``changed`` when any differs and ``unchanged``
        otherwise, so records at different ``at`` with equal compared fields
        are still ``unchanged``. ``summary`` has keys
        ``total, introduced, changed, unchanged`` with counts matching
        ``entries``. Caller order never affects the result.
        """
        if not isinstance(record_ids, list) or not record_ids:
            raise ValueError("record_ids must be a non-empty list of record id strings")
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for index, record_id in enumerate(record_ids):
            _check_non_empty_str(record_id, f"record_ids[{index}]")
            if record_id in seen:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"record_ids must not contain duplicates: {record_id!r}"
                )
            seen.add(record_id)
        _check_time(from_at, "from_at")
        _check_time(to_at, "to_at")
        if from_at > to_at:
            raise ValueError(
                f"from_at must not be after to_at: {from_at!r} > {to_at!r}"
            )

        def latest(record_id: str, at: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
            best: dict[str, Any] | None = None
            for entry in self._records:
                if entry["id"] == record_id and entry["at"] <= at:
                    if best is None or entry["at"] > best["at"]:
                        best = entry
            return best

        # Resolve every pair first; a missing after-snapshot fails the whole
        # diff before any result is built.
        snapshots: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None, dict[str, Any]]] = []
        for record_id in sorted(seen):
            after = latest(record_id, to_at)
            if after is None:
                raise KeyError(record_id)
            snapshots.append((record_id, latest(record_id, from_at), after))

        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        introduced = changed = unchanged = 0
        for record_id, before, after in snapshots:
            if before is None:
                kind = "introduced"
                changes: list[str] = []
                introduced += 1
            else:
                changes = [
                    field
                    for field in _EVOLUTION_FIELDS
                    if before[field] != after[field]
                ]
                if changes:
                    kind = "changed"
                    changed += 1
                else:
                    kind = "unchanged"
                    unchanged += 1
            entries.append(
                {
                    "id": record_id,
                    "kind": kind,
                    "before": copy.deepcopy(before),
                    "after": copy.deepcopy(after),
                    "changes": changes,
                }
            )
        return {
            "from": from_at,
            "to": to_at,
            "entries": entries,
            "summary": {
                "total": len(entries),
                "introduced": introduced,
                "changed": changed,
                "unchanged": unchanged,
            },
        }

import json

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from regulation_policy_compiler.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _rule(**overrides):
    rule = {
        "id": "r1",
        "ver": 1,
        "source": "law",
        "priority": 0,
        "from": "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "to": None,
        "when": None,
        "result": "allow",
    }
    rule.update(overrides)
    return rule


def _payload(**overrides):
    payload = {"at": "2021-06-01T00:00:00Z", "facts": {}, "rules": []}
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


def test_no_match_returns_null_basis_and_empty_conflicts():
    response = client.post("/explanations", json=_payload())
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        "at": "2021-06-01T00:00:00Z",
        "decision": None,
        "trace": [],
        "basis": None,
        "conflicts": [],
    }
    assert list(response.json()) == ["at", "decision", "trace", "basis", "conflicts"]


def test_match_returns_evaluate_outputs_and_basis_snapshot():
    rules = [_rule(when={"z": False, "a": True}, result="允许")]
    response = client.post(
        "/explanations", json=_payload(facts={"z": False, "a": True}, rules=rules)
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["at"] == "2021-06-01T00:00:00Z"
    assert data["decision"] == "允许"
    assert data["trace"] == ["r1@1"]
    assert data["basis"] == _rule(when={"z": False, "a": True}, result="允许")
    assert list(data["basis"]) == [
        "id",
        "ver",
        "source",
        "priority",
        "from",
        "to",
        "when",
        "result",
    ]
    assert list(data["basis"]["when"]) == ["a", "z"]
    assert data["conflicts"] == []


def test_conflicts_keep_only_entries_involving_basis_in_original_order():
    rules = [
        _rule(id="win", priority=9, result="allow"),
        _rule(id="other", source="org", priority=1, result="deny"),
        _rule(id="loser", priority=1, result="deny"),
    ]
    response = client.post("/explanations", json=_payload(rules=rules))
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["decision"] == "allow"
    assert data["basis"]["id"] == "win"
    # compile order is win (law p9), loser (law p1), other (org);
    # raw pairs: win-loser, win-other (loser-other share the same result).
    assert data["conflicts"] == [
        {"winner": ["law", "win", 1], "loser": ["law", "loser", 1]},
        {"winner": ["law", "win", 1], "loser": ["org", "other", 1]},
    ]
    for conflict in data["conflicts"]:
        assert list(conflict) == ["winner", "loser"]


def test_conflict_where_basis_is_loser_is_kept():
    rules = [
        _rule(id="top", priority=9, result="allow", when={"x": True}),
        _rule(id="base", priority=1, result="deny"),
    ]
    response = client.post("/explanations", json=_payload(facts={"x": False}, rules=rules))
    data = response.json()
    assert data["decision"] == "deny"
    assert data["basis"]["id"] == "base"
    assert data["trace"] == ["base@1"]
    assert data["conflicts"] == [
        {"winner": ["law", "top", 1], "loser": ["law", "base", 1]},
    ]


def test_winner_disambiguation_uses_source_not_just_trace_signature():
    # law r1@1 does not match; org r1@1 matches and wins. trace alone ("r1@1")
    # must not be misattributed to the law rule.
    rules = [
        _rule(id="r1", when={"a": True}),
        _rule(id="r1", source="org", priority=99, result="org-allow"),
    ]
    response = client.post("/explanations", json=_payload(facts={}, rules=rules))
    data = response.json()
    assert data["trace"] == ["r1@1"]
    assert data["basis"]["source"] == "org"
    assert data["decision"] == "org-allow"


def test_response_is_compact_utf8_without_trailing_newline():
    response = client.post(
        "/explanations", json=_payload(rules=[_rule(result="允许")])
    )
    raw = response.content.decode("utf-8")
    assert not raw.endswith("\n")
    assert ", " not in raw and '": ' not in raw
    assert "允许" in raw and "\\u" not in raw


def test_basis_is_a_deep_copy():
    # The response is serialized from snapshots; mutating input structures
    # cannot change the shape, and the compiled snapshot has its own when dict.
    when = {"z": True, "a": False}
    rules = [_rule(when=when)]
    response = client.post(
        "/explanations", json=_payload(facts={"z": True, "a": False}, rules=rules)
    )
    assert response.json()["basis"]["when"] == {"a": False, "z": True}
    assert when == {"z": True, "a": False}


def test_invalid_bodies_are_422():
    bad_bodies = [
        b"not json",
        b"[]",
        b"null",
        b'"x"',
        b"{}",
        json.dumps(_payload(extra=1)).encode(),
        json.dumps({"at": "2021-06-01T00:00:00Z", "facts": {}}).encode(),
    ]
    for raw in bad_bodies:
        response = client.post("/explanations", content=raw, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
        assert response.status_code == 422, raw
        assert response.json() == {"detail": "invalid request"}


def test_validation_failures_are_422():
    cases = [
        _payload(at="not-a-time"),
        _payload(facts={"x": 1}),
        _payload(facts=[]),
        _payload(rules={}),
        _payload(rules=[_rule(ver=0)]),
        _payload(rules=[_rule(), _rule()]),
        _payload(rules=[_rule(source="court")]),
    ]
    for payload in cases:
        response = client.post("/explanations", json=payload)
        assert response.status_code == 422, payload
        assert response.json() == {"detail": "invalid request"}


def test_endpoint_does_not_touch_history(monkeypatch):
    import regulation_policy_compiler.app as app_module

    class ExplodingHistory:
        def record(self, *args, **kwargs):
            raise AssertionError("POST /explanations must not write history")

    monkeypatch.setattr(app_module, "H", ExplodingHistory())
    response = client.post("/explanations", json=_payload(rules=[_rule()]))
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["decision"] == "allow"
